# 204Labs

> 204Labs FZE is an independent software company based in the United Arab Emirates. It builds and owns 4 software products.

## Products

- [Rewizz](https://www.204labs.com/products/rewizz/): Helping teachers get their time back. Status: Private beta. Website: https://rewizzapp.github.io/rewizzapp/
- [bAIsect](https://www.204labs.com/products/baisect/): For when building with AI gets you almost there. Status: In development. Website: https://www.baisect.com/
- [Sevaya.lk](https://www.204labs.com/products/sevaya/): Answers from official sources, with the source beside every one. Status: Launching soon. Website: https://www.sevaya.lk
- [FlatIntel](https://www.204labs.com/products/flatintel/): Know more before you sign the lease. Status: In development.
